content: उत्सेध {%a.%} High, tall. .{@-धः@} .²1 A height, elevation; (<ab>fig.</ab> also); पयोधरोत्सेधविशीर्णसंहति (वल्कलम्) <ls>Ku. 5. 8</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 5.">24</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>Kau. A. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Śukra. 4. 495</ls>; high or projecting breasts; सोत्सेधैः स्कन्धदेशैः <ls>Mu. 4. 7</ls> raised high up. .²2 Thickness, fatness. .²3 Intumescence, swelling. .²4 The body. .²5 Sublimity, greatness; prosperity; मामकस्यास्य सैन्यस्य हतोत्सेधस्य सञ्जय . अवशेषं न पश्यामि <ls>Mb. 8. 9. 93</ls>. .{@-धम्@} .²1 Killing, slaughter. .²2 The height from the basement to the top; उत्सेधं जन्मादिस्तूपिकान्तम् . <ls>Māna. 35. 26</ls>. The different technical names of the heights of the idols are शान्तिक, पौष्टिक, जयद, सार्वकामिक, धनद and अद्मुत. Their lengths are respectively 1¼th, 1½, 1⅓rd of their breadths.
